title: Origin story: Dagda
description: The Dagda was the father-god of the Tuatha De Danann, called the good god not for morals but for mastery of all things. His cauldron fed the world without emptying, his club slew nine at a blow and revived the slain at the other end, and his harp ordered the seasons.
